scope: Quote-preview configuration, hover behavior, mobile navigation companions and positioning from a permitted released public client; source inspected as text, not executed.

contract.setting_tip: Show post when mousing over post links
contract.visible_local_target: Temporary highlight instead of a popup or network request; top > 0, bottom < viewport height, not post-hidden.
contract.other_target: Clone an offscreen or hidden local target, or fetch the public thread containing a remote target.
contract.mobile_navigation: Adjacent a.quoteLink containing ' #' retains the same href while original quote activation opens the preview.
contract.desktop_position: Five pixels right unless near the rightmost 30% of the viewport, then left; vertically centered and clamped.
contract.mobile_position: Below the quote with the same horizontal side selection.

rewrite_boundaries: Use the typed rewrite quote path and a versioned single-post same-origin projection instead of external full-thread CORS fetching.
Use strict response, request, parser and DOM budgets; no credentials, redirect following or new CSP authority.
Construct from validated finite trees; remove duplicate IDs and interactive controls.
Retain ordinary navigation when bounded mobile companion decoration cannot fit.
Let a mobile primary click retain its active preview across compatibility mouseout while preserving ordinary hover cleanup on every device; source and lifecycle changes still cancel it.
No upstream runtime, real user posts or leaked source imported.
